notes: The verse-opening And is folded onto οἵτινες, the relative the ASV renders as a coordinate clause, rather than marked added under rule 86; 23:33 reads its identical οἵτινες the same way.
ἀνάθεμα is expressed here, so it takes under a great curse and the verb keeps only bound — the contrast with 23:12 and 23:21.
